faq_heading: Homes near William F. Davidson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the William F. Davidson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the William F. Davidson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names William F. Davidson Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to William F. Davidson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Johnston Heights Secondary (0.4 km west), Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km south-west) and Harold Bishop Elementary (0.9 km north).

How the William F. Davidson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names William F. Davidson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of William F. Davidson Elementary

23 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of William F. Davidson Elementary in a straight line (16 elementary, 5 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Johnston Heights Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Frost Road Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is St Matthew's Elementary (2.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is North Surrey Secondary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Mountainview Montessori (0.7 km south-west), Harold Bishop Elementary (0.9 km north), Berkshire Park Elementary (1.2 km south), Bonaccord Elementary (1.2 km west), Serpentine Heights Elementary (1.6 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Mountainview Montessori, 0.7 km south-west of William F. Davidson Elementary.
